name: design-prompt-provenance
goal: Preserve entity provenance and requested-area boundaries in reference-aware image prompts.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Commit b0f7feb536 replaced the prior Entity: title label when adding reference-aware scope instructions. At 5848e9de2d the existing visual-provenance case fails on that missing label; the entity title itself remains present.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing desktop run-integration case detects the regression. The earlier scoped-prompt work had no passing result for that consumer case on the integrated revision; keep the existing case in normal desktop verification and run it alongside the design-reference matrix.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 96661189902156d2a824a763085b181e6fe9289b1bf4957044aa71d866403171: the committed test at 618ffe5597 fails specifically on Entity: Target after both SvelteKit configs are generated in the clean snapshot.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Restore the Entity: title label and retain the original user request and reference-scoping instructions. The existing provenance case and design-reference matrix remain the guard.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Restored the explicit Entity label without changing reference preservation, edit-area or authoritative-request instructions. The existing committed provenance and scoped-reference tests remain the guard.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: a750ce55df4c907ef1ca3834f508657eaf618a46db4ced3257b2c6a13f67d799 passes the unchanged committed provenance case at 127e571d2b in the same runtime and environment as red dc154074f22bb70b19a52d351b0457797964682a82c438aa13d1db938521e04d.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: In an isolated export of 127e571d2b, restoring the original missing-label line made the identical case fail on Entity: Target; restoring the repair made it pass. Both runs used the same snapshot, dependencies, runtime and command.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
